games.title: Yunin's School Legacy
games.desc: Yunina's Awesome School is the best school because... well... I don't know what to say, just be jealous, she's the coolest (I'm sick of it).  Unfortunately, Baldi got really sick and asked Yunina to teach math instead of him.   There are 5 friends in the game: Yunina  Voca is Yunina's younger brother who loves balls;  Goffa is a bully who respects Yunina but sometimes doesn't even say her name;  Mr. Drawing - often envied by those who have more documents, but so cute when at home;  Electric Mop - gift from Red Ger.
